confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of German city price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is seasonal and event-sensitive, and July demand in Nuremberg can push hotel rates higher. The FX observation could not be confirmed against the full RBA F11 table; it comes from a single search snippet of the RBA homepage and is consistent with nearby third-party October 2026 rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Bavarian and Franconian German cities (for example Munich-adjacent and Würzburg-type price levels), with Nuremberg set slightly below Munich for restaurants and accommodation.
